verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Drive lets multiple users be granted edit/comment/view access to files and that permissions are inherited across folders, implying shared editing, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents real-time, simultaneous co-editing (live cursors, presence, concurrent typing) in Docs/Sheets/Slides. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of real-time simultaneous co-editing, presence indicators, or conflict-free concurrent edits in Docs/Sheets/Slides.
